nodes.summary: Itô's formula for Brownian motion: for a Brownian motion `B` adapted to `F` with increments independent of the past and jointly measurable in `(t, ω)`, and `f` of class `C²` with `|f'| ≤ C` and `|f''| ≤ C`, `f(B t) = f(B 0) + ∫_0^t f'(B u) dB u + (1/2) ∫_0^t f''(B u) du` almost surely, for every `t ≥ 0` (Karatzas–Shreve 1991, Theorem 3.3.3). The last integral is a pathwise Riemann integral; it is the integral of a…
nodes.title: Itô's formula

nodes.summary: The elementary Itô integral of `leftPoint` at time `t` is the left-point Itô sum `∑_{k < n} g(B (t k / n)) (B (t (k + 1) / n) - B (t k / n))`.
nodes.title: Itô integral of the left-point integrand is the left-point sum

nodes.summary: The left-point step process `∑_{k < n} g(B (t k / n)) 1_{(t k / n, t (k + 1) / n]}` of `u ↦ g (B u)` on the uniform partition of `[0, t]` into `n` cells.
nodes.title: Left-point step process along a Brownian path

nodes.summary: The left-point elementary integrand `∑_{k < n} g(B (t k / n)) 1_{(t k / n, t (k + 1) / n]}` of `u ↦ g (B u)` on the uniform partition of `[0, t]`, for a measurable `g` bounded by `C` and an adapted `B`.
nodes.title: Left-point elementary integrand along a Brownian path

nodes.summary: For a pre-Brownian motion `B` that is jointly measurable in `(u, ω)` and an `L`-Lipschitz `g`, the left-point step processes of `u ↦ g (B u)` converge to it in `L²(P ⊗ du)` on `(0, t] × Ω`: `E ∫_0^t |leftPointProcess g B t n u - g (B u)|² du → 0`.
nodes.title: Left-point approximation of a Lipschitz function of Brownian motion

nodes.summary: Left-point Riemann sums of a continuous function on the uniform partition of `[0, t]` converge to the integral: `∑_{k < n} g (t k / n) (t / n) → ∫_0^t g` (`t ≥ 0`).
nodes.title: Left-point Riemann sums of a continuous function

nodes.summary: For `f` of class `C²`, a continuous path `w`, `t ≥ 0`, and a sequence of mesh counts `ns j → ∞` along which the quadratic sums `∑_{k < ns j} (w (t (k + 1) / ns j) - w (t k / ns j))²` stay bounded, the telescoped increment `f (w t) - f (w 0)` minus the second-order Taylor sums `∑_k (f'(w_k) Δw_k + (1/2) f''(w_k) Δw_k²)` tends to `0`.
nodes.title: Second-order Taylor sums along a continuous path

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
